does: Returns the next 64-bit output of a Mersenne Twister: regenerates the state when the index is at its end, then tempers one word.

evidence.says: The tempering shifts are 29, 17, 37 and 43 with the masks of the standard 64-bit generator, after the same state update as the discard
A model of the standard generator reproduces the dice of the Generic stream at seed 1 for the counts 0 to 14 and four dice chosen beforehand
The name is the C++ standard library's for this generator's member, taken from the constants its read shows; no store of the game names the function.
